project_info.theme: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G exclusive Shopee financing poster
project_info.color_palette: Clean white, Shopee orange, black, peach, cyan gradient

main_subject.detail: Minimal clean poster with top branding 'Shopee' and 'SAMSUNG'. Main copy reads 'Galaxy A27 5G Moi', 'Dac Quyen Thanh Toan - On Ap Chot Luon!', and 'SPayLater'. A wide orange info card states 'Chi tu 1.415.000 d/thang', 'Tang ngay sac nhanh 25w', and 'Tra gop 0% Ky han len den 6 thang'. A CTA pill says 'MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE'. At bottom, HIEUTHUHAI poses in a black leather jacket while presenting a large Galaxy phone toward the camera. Top-right badge reads 'CON 1 NGAY 25.6 SALE LUONG VE'.
main_subject.style: Premium clean launch poster with editorial white space, celebrity cutout, and realistic device render
